summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): East Malaysia - its own, less expansive Shariah enactments than the peninsular states, with no equivalent gender-transition offence found and no state-specific incident data; less religiously policed. Plausibly above the national score (0.16) for Malaysia, but undocumented; direction: less religiously policed.

sources.summary: NOTE: Not retrievable at research time (HTTP 403); the underlying Human Dignity Trust country profile documents Malaysia's criminalisation of same-sex activity (Penal Code 377, up to 20 years and whipping) and state Sharia provisions.
Human Rights Watch (Aug 2022): 'Malaysia: State-Backed Discrimination Harms LGBT People' - documents how state agencies, laws and policies discriminate against LGBT Malaysians.

Human Rights Watch (Jun 2019): 'The Deceased Can't Speak for Herself' - violence against LGBT people in Malaysia, following the killing of a transgender woman, with police mistreatment and impunity documented.
